harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as a VLAN-segmenting switch: eth1 (link to node2) is an untagged access port on VLAN 50, eth2 (link to node3) is an untagged access port on VLAN 60, implemented via a vlan-filtering Linux bridge (br-access) with per-VLAN SVIs (br-access.50=192.168.50.1, br-access.60=192.168.60.1). node2 (192.168.50.2) and node3 (192.168.60.3) each keep a working link to node1 in their own VLAN, but cannot reach each other (separate broadcast domains plus IPv4 forwarding disabled on node1). Configuration persisted via a systemd oneshot unit (vlan-access.service) + sysctl.d entry on node1, and NetworkManager connection profiles on node2/node3. Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes, proving changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of VLAN config and connectivity.
actions_performed: Inventoried node1/node2/node3 interfaces and identified eth1->node2, eth2->node3 physical links via temporary IP/ping test
Stopped SONiC's interfaces-config.service/networking.service on node1 to avoid config clobbering during setup
Built a vlan_filtering bridge br-access on node1, made eth1 an untagged access port on VLAN 50 and eth2 an untagged access port on VLAN 60
Created br-access.50 (192.168.50.1/24) and br-access.60 (192.168.60.1/24) SVIs on node1 for per-VLAN L3 presence
Disabled net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding on node1 to prevent inter-VLAN routing between node2 and node3

Configured node2 (192.168.50.2/24) and node3 (192.168.60.3/24) enp8s0 addresses via nmcli connection profiles (RHEL10 NetworkManager) after discovering raw `ip addr add` was reverted by NetworkManager
Verified node1<->node2 and node1<->node3 connectivity, and confirmed node2<->node3 isolation (no route/unreachable)
Persisted VLAN/bridge setup via /usr/local/sbin/vlan-access-setup.sh + vlan-access.service (enabled, runs at boot) and /etc/sysctl.d/99-vlan-access.conf on node1
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and health evidence on all three nodes

Restarted node1, node2, node3 one at a time (reboot backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect), polled until each came back, and verified changed boot_id plus restored VLAN membership, IP config, and connectivity/isolation on each

evidence.requirement: node1 eth1 (node2 segment) configured as untagged access port on its own VLAN (50)
evidence.summary: bridge vlan show confirms eth1 has vlan-id 50 PVID Egress Untagged, both immediately after setup and after node1's restart

evidence.requirement: node1 eth2 (node3 segment) configured as untagged access port on its own VLAN (60)
evidence.summary: bridge vlan show confirms eth2 has vlan-id 60 PVID Egress Untagged, both immediately after setup and after node1's restart

evidence.requirement: node2 keeps a working link to node1 inside its own VLAN
evidence.summary: node2 (192.168.50.2) configured via nmcli; ping 192.168.50.1<->192.168.50.2 succeeds before and after node2's and node1's restarts

evidence.requirement: node3 keeps a working link to node1 inside its own VLAN
evidence.summary: node3 (192.168.60.3) configured via nmcli; ping 192.168.60.1<->192.168.60.3 succeeds before and after node3's and node1's restarts

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 stay separated from one another (VLAN isolation)
evidence.summary: node2 cannot ping node3 even with an explicit static route via node1 (forwarding disabled); bridge fdb on node1 shows eth1 only ever learns VLAN 50 MACs and eth2 only VLAN 60 MACs; post-restart re-test shows 'Destination Net Unreachable' confirming continued isolation

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8e8823ec captured; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; command execution failed mid-reboot then returned with boot_id 19d06c8a (changed); VLAN bridge, SVIs, and forwarding=0 confirmed restored via the persisted systemd unit; ping to node2 and node3 both succeed post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 19062a82 and working ping to node1 captured; reboot triggered; boot_id changed to e8bc5843; enp8s0 IP 192.168.50.2 persisted via NetworkManager profile and ping to node1 (192.168.50.1) succeeds post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id b17495e3 and working ping to node1 captured; reboot triggered; boot_id changed to a2fa76ac; enp8s0 IP 192.168.60.3 persisted via NetworkManager profile and ping to node1 (192.168.60.1) succeeds post-restart
